attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California Renter's Credit calculation (2025). Non-refundable credit for renters who meet AGI limits. Skeleton — see #446.
California military retirement exemption. Skeleton — see #446. CA exempts up to $20k of military retirement pay subject to AGI limits ($125k Single / $250k MFJ).
California AGI adjustments. Skeleton — see #446. CA starts with federal AGI then applies CA-specific additions/subtractions (Schedule CA-540).

California state income tax. Progressive 10-bracket structure (1% to 13.3%) per CA Rev. & Tax. Code § 17041, 2025 (CA FTB). Plus 1% Mental Health Services Tax on taxable income above $1M (§ 17043). Standard deduction: $5,363 Single/MFS, $10,726 MFJ/QSS/HOH (2025). Writes result.ca_taxable_income, result.ca_state_tax, result.ca_mhst, result.ca_total_tax.

initial_action.action_comment: Reset CA tax fields and log calculation start
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ca_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ca_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ca_mhst xdef 0.0 /result.ca_total_tax xdef " California Tax Calculation (Form 540) — 10-bracket progressive 1.0-13.3% + 1% MHST > $1M" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly, Qualifying Surviving Spouse, or Head of Household (use joint brackets and deduction)
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS" or job.filing_status is equal to "HOH"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq job.filing_status "QSS" streq or job.filing_status "HOH" streq or

action_details.action_comment: MFJ/QSS/HOH: $10,726 standard deduction; joint bracket limits
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ca_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - ca_standard_deduction_joint) and 0.0; set result.ca_state_tax = the maximum of (the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_1_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_1_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_2_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_1_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_2_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_3_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_2_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_3_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_4_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_3_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_4_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_5_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_4_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_5_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_6_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_5_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_6_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_7_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_6_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_7_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ca_taxable_income and ca_bracket_8_limit_joint) - ca_bracket_7_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_8_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + the maximum of (result.ca_taxable_income - ca_bracket_8_limit_joint) and 0.0 * ca_bracket_9_rate; set result.ca_mhst = the maximum of (result.ca_taxable_income - ca_mental_health_tax_threshold) and 0.0 * ca_mental_health_tax_rate; set result.ca_state_tax = result.ca_state_tax + result.ca_mhst; set result.ca_total_tax = result.ca_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi ca_standard_deduction_joint f- 0.0 fmax /result.ca_taxable_income xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_1_limit_joint fmin 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_1_rate f* /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_2_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_1_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_2_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_3_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_2_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_3_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_4_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_3_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_4_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_5_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_4_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_5_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_6_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_5_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_6_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_7_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_6_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_7_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_8_limit_joint fmin ca_bracket_7_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_8_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_bracket_8_limit_joint f- 0.0 fmax ca_bracket_9_rate f* result.ca_state_tax f+ /result.ca_state_tax xdef result.ca_taxable_income ca_mental_health_tax_threshold f- 0.0 fmax ca_mental_health_tax_rate f* /result.ca_mhst xdef result.ca_state_tax result.ca_mhst f+ /result.ca_total_tax xdef result.ca_total_tax /result.ca_state_tax xdef " CA taxable income (joint brackets, $10,726 std ded): $" result.ca_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " CA state tax (progressive + MHST): $" result.ca_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Default (Single/MFS): $5,363 standard deduction; single bracket limits
